database: Local development PostgreSQL 127.0.0.1:54329/ltw (the default; .env.local sets no DATABASE_URL). Records are database state, not repository content; a database reset removes them.

billingAccount.providerAccountRef: anthropic-console:owner-primary-api-key (the owner's Anthropic Console account whose key is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.local; operator-attested, not provider-verified)

readBack: Rows in ltw_ai_billing_accounts, ltw_ai_account_revisions, ltw_ai_approvals and ltw_ai_approval_revisions match the values above; operator status: 0 open holds, 0 stops, 0 incomplete requests.
stillInert: No paid call is possible until .env.local selects remote routes (LTW_AI_ROUTES) and this approval (LTW_AI_APPROVAL_ID=stage-300-sonnet); neither is set. Any live run needs separate owner authorization.
